purpose: Neural-only follow-up: numeric piecewise-linear embeddings and feature-token Transformer; conditional positive-target regression
motivation: V5 best neural MAE606, v6 regional attention worse. Test nonlinear feature representation and a positive-only conditional count loss instead of more spatial attention.
features: V5 fine subset only; train-only standardization and eight quantile intervals for piecewise-linear numeric embeddings. No year, VIIRS history, CAL FIRE or boosted teacher.
optimizer: MPS AdamW lr .001 weight_decay .01, dropout .1, gradient clip5, cosine to .0001 over320 epochs, eight full months per batch
loss: .05 positive-target-only Poisson conditional-mean loss + .2 binary-presence BCE + statewide monthly smoothL1 beta100 /1000 + .25 north/south monthly smoothL1 beta100 /1000. Mean prediction = presence probability times positive conditional mean >=1.
architecture: Raw/embedded MLP width64 depth2; feature Transformer16 dimensions heads2 layers2 plus CLS token per cell. Embedding quantiles learned on training inputs only. Seasonal ratio count offset remains unbounded, learned corrections bounded.
selection_rule: Epoch chosen on2019-2020 ensemble monthly MAE, then refit2013-2020. Select family using2021-2022 only, save selection before new winner benchmark. Report all failures and seed variation; no tuning on2023-2025.
limits: Exploratory iterative reuse of known historical periods, target <500 is not independent evidence. No automatic production change.
